card.name: Linking words after ECG changes
card.fires_on: Linking words or punctuation right after ECG or electrocardiogram changes, such as 'such as', 'particularly', or an opening parenthesis. They lead into a list of specific ECG findings.

modes.label: such as
modes.description: The word 'as' in 'such as' after ECG changes or abnormalities.
modes.example: ECG changes such<< as>> conduction disturbances or arrhythmias.

modes.label: Parenthesis or 'particularly'
modes.description: An opening bracket or 'particularly' right after electrocardiogram wording, introducing the specific finding.
modes.example: Changes in the electrocardiogram,<< particularly>> in QRS axis or width, are
